claims.claim_text: Net sales increased 7% to $60.4 billion in fiscal 2026 (vs $56.4B fiscal 2025); consolidated comp sales increased 5% (driven by higher average basket and increase in customer transactions). Both home and apparel comp sales generally performed in line with overall comp sales.
claims.rationale: Direct comp-store-sales trajectory claim. Control test for distress framework: a healthy off-price retailer should pass cleanly across counterparty external-validation tests. Calibration Heuristic 9 (comp-store-sales).

queries.expectation: Many third-party mentions of the TJ Maxx brand in supplier/landlord 10-Ks if TJX is a material counterparty.
Asymmetric mention test — broad TJX mentions across filers.

claims.claim_text: Operates over 5,200 stores at end of fiscal 2026 across four segments (Marmaxx 2,603; HomeGoods/Homesense U.S. 1,042; TJX Canada 589; TJX International 747 Europe + 88 Australia). Both store count and selling square footage increased approximately 3% YoY.
claims.rationale: Store-count trajectory (Calibration Heuristic 11). Sum check: 2,603 + 145 (Sierra) + 1,042 + 589 + 747 + 88 = 5,214 (matches 'over 5,200'). Net store growth claim is internally testable; absence of mass-closure 8-Ks should corroborate.

queries.expectation: International banner mentioned in landlord/supplier filings if real.

claims.claim_text: TJX is a major tenant in U.S. retail real estate — operates 3,790 U.S. stores across Marmaxx, Sierra, and HomeGoods, virtually all leased, with typical 10-year initial lease terms. Off-price banners are traditional anchor/junior-anchor tenants for mall REITs and shopping-center landlords.
claims.rationale: Counterparty cross-check via mall-REIT top-tenant disclosure (Calibration Heuristic 7). SPG (Simon) and MAC (Macerich) disclose top tenants; absence-where-claimed would be HARD CONTRADICTION but expectation is strong corroboration for TJX.

queries.expectation: Simon Property Group 10-K should mention TJX as a tenant given off-price tenant prevalence.
Macerich filings should mention TJX as a tenant.

claims.claim_text: TJX's opportunistic buying model sources merchandise from over 21,000 vendors globally (implied by general disclosure), including from China, India, and southeastern Asia; off-price model relies on closeout / opportunistic purchases from branded suppliers.
claims.rationale: Counterparty cross-check via apparel-supplier 10-Ks (Calibration Heuristic 7). Hanesbrands, Levi, VF Corp, Tapestry should mention TJX/Marshalls/TK Maxx as a meaningful off-price channel if claim is real. ABSENCE while TJX claims broad supplier base would be material.

queries.expectation: Hanesbrands may disclose off-price channel mention of TJX brands.
VF Corp disclosure of Marshalls as an off-price channel.
Tapestry disclosure addressing the off-price channel where TJX dominates.

claims.claim_text: Strong liquidity: $6.2 billion cash on balance sheet at Jan 31, 2026; $1.5B available under credit facility; no short-term bank borrowings or commercial paper outstanding. $4.3B returned to shareholders via buybacks ($2.5B) and dividends ($1.8B) in fiscal 2026; new $3B repurchase authorization approved by Board.
claims.rationale: Direct distress-marker test (Layer 3 Rule 10). Healthy retailer profile: no going-concern, no covenant waivers, no form-15-12G, large capital-return program. Counterparty: bank/credit-card partners (Visa, AmEx) referenced through interchange-fee settlement gain ($419M).

queries.expectation: American Express may mention TJX in merchant-acceptance / interchange context.
Visa 10-K should reference the merchant interchange litigation TJX cites a settlement gain from.

claims.claim_text: Planned international expansion: announced expansion into Spain starting March 2026 (TK Maxx); joint venture with Grupo Axo (Mexico); minority equity investment in BFL (Middle East). Capex guidance $2.2-2.3B for fiscal 2027 supports growth.
claims.rationale: Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational). Spain entry is a forward claim with concrete near-term execution timing (March 2026). External corroboration via mention by JV partner / international landlord disclosure should appear.

queries.expectation: Mention of TJX's Mexican JV partner Grupo Axo in any SEC filings.
Internal consistency on Spain expansion across TJX's own filings.
